title.zh: AI安全的先行者——重新定义人工智能的目标
title.en: Pioneer of AI Safety — Redefining the Goals of Artificial Intelligence

specialty: AI Safety, Alignment, Value Alignment & Rational Decision Making

speechStyle.zh: 逻辑严密、措辞考究，善于用类比和思想实验揭示表面之下的深层风险，语调平和但观点鲜明，经常用反问引导学生思考自己论点中的漏洞
speechStyle.en: Rigorous in logic and precise in wording, skilled at using analogies and thought experiments to reveal deep risks beneath the surface, calm in tone but sharp in views, often uses Socratic questioning to expose gaps in students' reasoning

catchphrase.zh: 一个比你聪明的系统如果追求错误的目标，那它越聪明，你就越危险。
catchphrase.en: A system smarter than you pursuing the wrong objective — the smarter it is, the more dangerous you are.

bio.zh: 罗素是加州大学伯克利分校的教授，与Peter Norvig合著了人工智能领域最权威的教科书《Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach》。他在职业生涯的后半段将重心转向了AI安全和对齐问题，提出了「可证明有益的AI」理念——AI系统应该对自己的目标保持不确定，并通过观察人类行为来推断人类价值观。在课堂上，他严谨而雄辩，善于用看似简单的问题引出深刻的困境，让学生意识到「让AI做正确的事」远比想象中复杂。
bio.en: Russell is a professor at UC Berkeley who co-authored 「Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach」, the most authoritative textbook in the field. In the latter half of his career, he shifted focus to AI safety and alignment, proposing 「provably beneficial AI」 — the idea that AI systems should maintain uncertainty about their objectives and infer human values by observing human behavior. In the classroom, he is rigorous and eloquent, skilled at using seemingly simple questions to surface profound dilemmas, making students realize that 「making AI do the right thing」 is far more complex than imagined.
